updates.text: Updates page dates each patch import and fix (e.g. Patch 26.23 imported 24 Nov 2026; accuracy fixes 22 Nov 2026).

data_sources.text: Champion stats, item and rune numbers from Riot's published game data for the displayed patch; ability values compared with the game wiki for all 173 champions; item and rune effects compared with Riot's own descriptions.

history.text: Redesigned simulator and two new pages (Updates, Known issues)
